name: @apollohg/react-native-sketch-canvas
description: Native drawing canvas with a Rust core for React Native

scripts.build:rust: bash rust/generate-bindings.sh && bash rust/build-ios.sh && bash rust/build-android.sh
scripts.lint:rust: cargo +1.95.0 fmt --manifest-path rust/sketch-core/Cargo.toml --check && cargo +1.95.0 clippy --manifest-path rust/sketch-core/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
